digest.component_or_area: src/rebar/llm core (runner, capabilities, providers, structured modules)
propositions: Comment at runner.py:94-97 claiming extra_tools 'is always None in practice' is stale; the field is live and set by completion_recovery.py:469,665 and tested in test_completion_banking.py:491

Three sites document Anthropic 400 errors on extended-thinking + native-output-constraint, contradicting structured.py:228-238 which labels this rationale stale; the actual gate involves native_structured_output and tool_choice, not json_schema output constraints

capabilities.py:166-198 contains a structurally complete ADR-format block (security posture for web-search capability with three bounds and accepted limitations) not reflected in any ADR in the corpus and should be migrated to new ADR 0063
providers.py:3-16 duplicates ADR 0059 section 1 verbatim including file:line citations and should be collapsed to a citation
capabilities.py:295-316 (AWS-cost measured-fact matrix) and capabilities.py:269-281 (rejected-alternative warning) are load-bearing invariant documentation that must remain verbatim
Comment-line recovery via relocation and deletion of stale/superseded units yields net 46 lines without behavioral change and runner.py remains at 800-line ceiling
